name: generalist-workspace
description: Effect-native agent framework with an optional durable Runtime

scripts.check: bun run build && bun run docs:build && prettier --cache --check . && repo-lint check --no-cache && bun node_modules/oxlint/dist/cli.js --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern 'docs/src/snippets/**' --ignore-pattern 'packages/generalist/test/package/core-consumer.ts' --ignore-pattern 'packages/generalist/test/package/extensions-consumer.ts' packages docs/src docs/server docs/vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts && ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml --filter '^(no-|tenant-|update-)' && bun run typecheck
scripts.package: bun run build && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release && bun pm --cwd packages/generalist pack --filename release/generalist.tgz --ignore-scripts && (cd release && sha256sum generalist.tgz > SHA256SUMS) && bun packages/generalist/test/package/qualify.ts
scripts.test: bun run build && bun --bun vitest run
scripts.typecheck: ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml --filter '^effect-' --report-style short && bun turbo typecheck && bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
